mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_event ( id, device_id, product_key, rule_key, rule_name, source_type, severity, property_id, policy_runtime_revision, policy_snapshot_id, policy_content_hash, raised_at, raised_evidence, raised_event_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{payload.alarmOccurrenceId}, #{payload.deviceId}, #{payload.productKey}, #{payload.ruleKey}, #{payload.ruleName}, #{payload.sourceType}, #{payload.severity}, #{payload.propertyId}, #{payload.policyRuntimeRevision}, #{payload.policySnapshotId}, #{payload.policyContentHash}, #{payload.raisedAt}, CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSONB), #{eventId}, #{now}, #{now} )

INSERT INTO alarm_event ( id, device_id, product_key, rule_key, rule_name, source_type, severity, property_id, policy_runtime_revision, policy_snapshot_id, policy_content_hash, raised_at, recovered_at, recovered_evidence, recovered_event_id, recovery_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{payload.alarmOccurrenceId}, #{payload.deviceId}, #{payload.productKey}, #{payload.ruleKey}, #{payload.ruleName}, #{payload.sourceType}, #{payload.severity}, #{payload.propertyId}, #{payload.policyRuntimeRevision}, #{payload.policySnapshotId}, #{payload.policyContentHash}, #{payload.raisedAt}, #{payload.recoveredAt}, CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSONB), #{eventId}, #{payload.recoveryReason}, #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_event SET raised_evidence = CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSONB), raised_event_id = #{eventId}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{alarmId} AND raised_event_id IS NULL

UPDATE alarm_event SET recovered_at = #{recoveredAt}, recovered_evidence = CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSONB), recovered_event_id = #{eventId}, recovery_reason = #{recoveryReason}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{alarmId} AND recovered_event_id IS NULL
